item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 31/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be showers over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine and persistently very hot weather to the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week, but thundery showers triggered by high temperatures will affect inland areas. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nongfa will move into the inland areas of Indo-China and dissipate gradually today.
